English.description: West Germanic language, global lingua franca, primary modern donor to Russian

French.description: Romance language; major donor to Russian in 18–19th century (culture, fashion, cuisine)

German.description: West Germanic; significant donor under Peter I (military, crafts, science)

Greek/Latin.description: Classical languages; primary source for scientific, religious and academic terminology

Arabic/Persian.description: Semitic/Iranian languages; donors via trade and religion (Middle Ages, Silk Road)

Turkic.description: Turkic family; donor via Mongol period and steppe contact (military, trade, nomadic life)

Italian.description: Romance language; donor especially in music, art, finance and military (16–18th century)

Dutch.description: West Germanic; donor under Peter I (seafaring, navigation, shipbuilding)

Slavic.description: Native Slavic heritage; not a donor — origin language of the core Russian lexicon
